$this->addHeaderCSS('assets/css/login.css');

Currently this change causes the custom header CSS test to fail (TestOfTestController::testAddCSS2Header) because you moved the {foreach from=$header_scripts item=script} bit into the else area.

I'm fixing now, but wanted you to know 1.) about the custom CSS assignment mechanism, and 2.) that we really have to get you running the whole test suite. :)
